subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
The input to a linear delta modulator having step-size 
 = 0.628 is a sine wave with frequency fm and peak 
amplitude Am. If the sampling frequency fs = 40 kHz, 
the combination of the sine wave frequency and the 
peak amplitude, where slope overload will take place 
is 
 
 
Am 
fm 
 
(a) 0.3 V 
8 kHz 
 
(b) 1.5 V 
4 kHz 
 
(c) 1.5 V 
2 kHz 
 
(d) 3.0 V 
1 kHz
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-05 (ECE/IN).
